title: Data of the crowd movement experiment.

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Complete source figure cohorts; F3D and F3E are linked as the multidirectional-study family and reserved together. Person/run identifiers are missing, so independence within or between figure cohorts is not established.

calibration_burden: No held-condition speed calibration. The supplied paper fit is an explicitly exposed prior-art baseline, not a newly discovered coefficient set.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: Source-processed paired density/speed ordinates, used for retrospective condition transfer. Density is the published local spatial descriptor; the task is not an online evacuation forecast.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Missing person/run IDs and linked published panels; no independent-crowd generalization.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.

practical_use_contract.decision_or_analysis: Estimate pedestrian speed under the exact registered input budget
practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated
practical_use_contract.inputs_available_when: Source-processed paired density/speed ordinates, used for retrospective condition transfer. Density is the published local spatial descriptor; the task is not an online evacuation forecast.
practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: No held-condition speed calibration. The supplied paper fit is an explicitly exposed prior-art baseline, not a newly discovered coefficient set.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
practical_use_contract.failure_boundary: Missing person/run IDs and linked published panels; no independent-crowd generalization.

default_numerical_evidence.lowest_error_interpretation: Retrospective description of all frozen alternatives, including attempts and possible aliases; not a new selection or independent baseline.

case_specific_next_evidence: Missing person/run IDs and linked published panels; no independent-crowd generalization.
